clips.title: The story
paras: As young tauren prepare to depart their ancestral training grounds on Red Cloud Mesa, Chief Hawkwind asks them to perform a final favor. He entrusts them with a bundle of essential supplies meant for Kaga Wildhoof, a seasoned wanderer camped near Bloodhoof Village who once aided the chief in his own past.

Before travelers descend the mesa path toward the broader plains of Mulgore, Chief Hawkwind pauses to address unfinished personal debts. Long before guiding new generations of hunters and shamans on Camp Narache, Hawkwind crossed paths with Kaga Wildhoof. Described by the chief as an accomplished adventurer, Wildhoof provided vital aid when he needed it most. Hearing that she has pitched camp just outside Bloodhoof Village, Hawkwind uses the departure of newly proven novices to send provisions to his old benefactor.

This errand marks a pivotal rite of passage for young Horde champions leaving Red Cloud Mesa. The trail down the plateau leads directly toward Bloodhoof Village, the cultural and logistical heart of central Mulgore. Carrying the supply bundle across the plains bridges the sheltered training life of the mesa with the wider, wilder struggles of the United Tauren Tribes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, adventurer.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
